headline.basis: task span minus the teacher's own end-of-text token

_source: scripts/branch_kl_fused.py, jobs 3170965 (no adapters) and 3173215 (deployed pair); branches and oracle are the NO-ADAPTER models, ours is the deployed pool at lam 0.7 — fine-tuning is part of the method, not a variant of the branches. The headline drops the teacher's own end-of-text token (one per ended answer, 1.18% of the span): there the deployed pool is 8.70 nats and the un-tuned pool 1.36, so that token measures where an arm stops rather than whether its answer is right.
